Enter the absorbance change of the control and the sample and it computes the inhibition rate and interprets the result.
map.📖 查看「农药残留酶抑制率速测使用指南」: 📖 Read the "Pesticide Residue Enzyme Inhibition Rapid Test Usage Guide"
map.酶抑制率 =（对照吸光度变化 ΔA₀ − 样品变化 ΔA）÷ ΔA₀ × 100: Enzyme inhibition rate = (control absorbance change ΔA₀ − sample change ΔA) ÷ ΔA₀ × 100%. ΔA₀ should fall between 0.3 and 0.8: too low means insufficient enzyme activity, too high means dilute and retest. An inhibition rate of at least 50% is positive, suggesting organophosphorus or carbamate residues above the limit, while below 50% is negative and passes.
map.提示：ΔA 为反应前后吸光度变化值，通常由分光光度计/农残速测仪自动读取。若 Δ: Note: ΔA is the absorbance change before and after the reaction, usually read automatically by a spectrophotometer or a pesticide residue analyser. If ΔA0 < 0.3, enzyme activity is insufficient and the reagent must be prepared again.
map.酶抑制率法依据 GB/T 5009.199-2003，适用于有机磷和氨基甲酸酯类: The enzyme inhibition method follows GB/T 5009.199-2003 and suits rapid screening for organophosphorus and carbamate residues
map.抑制率 ≥50% 为阳性（不合格），需用色谱法确证；35%-50% 为可疑需复测: An inhibition rate of at least 50% is positive (fails) and needs chromatographic confirmation; 35%-50% is suspect and needs retesting; below 35% is negative (passes)
map.对照 ΔA0 应在 0.3-0.8 范围内，否则说明酶活性异常，需重新配制试剂: The control ΔA0 should fall in the 0.3-0.8 range; otherwise enzyme activity is abnormal and the reagent must be prepared again
map.本方法为快速筛查，不能替代气相/液相色谱的确证分析: This method is a rapid screen and cannot replace confirmatory analysis by gas or liquid chromatography

map.果蔬有机磷快检: Rapid organophosphorus testing of fruit and vegetables
map.抑制率(%) = (ΔA₀ − ΔA_t)/ΔA₀ ×100（ΔA 为吸光度变化: Inhibition rate (%) = (ΔA₀ − ΔA_t)/ΔA₀ × 100, where ΔA is the absorbance change; at least 50% is positive, 15–50% suspect and below 15% negative.
Control ΔA₀ = 0.500 and sample ΔA_t = 0.300: inhibition rate = (0.500 − 0.300)/0.500 × 100 = 40%, which falls in the suspect range, so retest or send it for chromatographic confirmation.
map.阳性就能判定超标吗？: Does a positive result mean the limit is exceeded?
map.不能。酶抑制法为初筛，阳性仅提示可能含有机磷/氨基甲酸酯，须 GC/LC-MS: No. The enzyme inhibition method is only a screen: a positive result suggests possible organophosphorus or carbamate residues that must be confirmed and quantified by GC/LC-MS.
map.ΔA₀ 过低酶活性不足、过高试剂异常，均影响抑制率可靠性，须重配酶液。: A ΔA₀ that is too low means insufficient enzyme activity and one that is too high means an abnormal reagent; both undermine the reliability of the inhibition rate, so remake the enzyme solution.
map.关于「农残快速检测（酶抑制率）结果判读」: About the Pesticide Residue Rapid Test (Enzyme Inhibition Rate) Interpretation
map.酶抑制率法是蔬菜水果中有机磷和氨基甲酸酯类农药残留快速筛查的常用方法（GB/T: The enzyme inhibition method is a common rapid screen for organophosphorus and carbamate pesticide residues in vegetables and fruit (GB/T 5009.199-2003). Its principle is that pesticides inhibit cholinesterase activity, so measuring the absorbance change of the enzyme-catalysed reaction gives the inhibition rate, which indirectly reflects the residue level.
